programme.title: Bizarre food: culinary trips / Skurrile Kost: Kulinarische Reisen
programme.desc: It doesn't always have to be bizarre and unusual, that is the motto of this `everything-eating spin-offs with Andrew Zimmer. Instead, this time he can be spoiled with culinary costings from the hottest cities in the world. / Es muss nicht immer skurril und ungewohnlich sein, das ist das Motto dieses `Alles-Esser-Spin-Offs mit Andrew Zimmern. Stattdessen lasst er sich diesmal mit kulinarischen Kostlichkeiten aus den angesagtesten Metropolen der Welt verwohnen.

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.desc: The criminal officer Adrian Monk quickly became a little bit of a small body due to his special facilities in his profession. He has a photographic memory and can make a track even from the smallest indications. Since the death of his beloved wife Trudy due to a mysterious attack, however, he has suffered from strong fears and obsessive -he -forcendants, which leads to his suspension from service at the San Fransisco Police Department. After he has locked himself up in his apartment for three years, he finally becomes a self -timed as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming Lost Monk, the crime trap that nobody else can loose. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to drive a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police service. From then on he is investigating with Commissioner Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: Smart10 - the quiz with the ten possibilities / Smart10 - Das Quiz mit den zehn Moglichkeiten
programme.desc: Two teams of two compete against each other in the knowledge duel at Caroline Athanasiadis. The participants have to demonstrate general knowledge, good teamwork, tactics and risk giving away in order to successfully cut off. / Zwei Zweierteams treten im Wissensduell bei Caroline Athanasiadis gegeneinander an. Dabei mussen die Teilnehmer Allgemeinwissen, gutes Teamwork, Taktik und Risikoeinschatzung unter Beweis stellen, um erfolgreich abzuschneiden.

programme.title: Q1 A note is wrong / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First the topic of the term searched is announced. With the help of four notes, the candidates should get on the right track - but only three of them are correct. / Bei diesem Quiz dreht sich alles um Hinweise. Zuerst wird das Thema des gesuchten Begriffes bekannt gegeben. Mithilfe von vier Hinweisen sollen die Kandidaten auf die richtige Spur kommen - doch nur drei davon sind richtig.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.desc: A cruel violent crime is done on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. In order to clear it up, the London investigator Richard Poole is put on the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but at all it cannot make friends with the Caribbean mentality. This always ensures entertaining situations. The meticulous suit runner succeeds in loosening the case together with his colleagues on site. They absolutely want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like the sea fruit. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.desc: The Tyrolean Unterland with its outstanding sporting and tourist offers is the scene of the police team around criminal officer Karin Kofler and her colleague Lukas Roither, which specializes in criminal psychology, who, with a lot of expertise and empathy, put the craft from the local criminals. The investigators are understood by Karin's father Hannes, who runs the legendary inn "Pochlarner Stuben", and is blessed with a similar criminalistic sense of gaze. And finally there is Grafin Schonberg, who, with her contacts to the Kitzbuheler JetSet, proves again and again as valuable help for the officials. / Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. Dabei werden die Ermittler von Karins Vater Hannes unterstutzt, der das legendare Gasthaus "Pochlarner Stuben" betreibt, und mit ahnlichem kriminalistischen Spursinn gesegnet ist wie seine Tochter. Und schlieSSlich ist da noch Grafin Schonberg, die sich mit ihren Kontakten zum Kitzbuheler Jetset immer wieder als wertvolle Hilfe fur die Beamten erweist.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

Football: UEFA European Women's Championship 2025: quarterfinals: Norway - Italy / Футбол: УЕФА Европейско първенство за жени 2025: Четвъртфинал: Норвегия - Италия
programme.desc: The 16 best ladies' teams on the continent gather in Switzerland to fight for the Cup in the 14th European Championship. The team of England will defend its title, won 3 years ago on home land. The biggest competitors are the world champions from Spain, who are the team with the most front ranking in Europe in the FIFA rankings- second place. The German squad, which lost the final 3 years ago, is a record holder for European victories, triumphed 8 times in the previous 13 editions, but their last title has been in 2013 in the top ten of the world rankings are the teams of Sweden and France. / 16-те най-добри дамски отбора на континента се събират в Швейцария, за да се борят за купата в 14-ия европейски шампионат. Отборът на Англия ще защитава титлата си, спечелена преди 3 години на родна земя. Най-големите конкурентки са световните шампионки от Испания, които са и отборът с най- предно класиране от Европа в ранглистата на ФИФА – второ място. Съставът на Германия, който загуби финала преди 3 години след продължения, е рекордьор по европейски победи, като е триумфирал 8 пъти в досегашните 13 издания, но последната им титла е от 2013 г. В първата десетка на световната ранглиста са още отборите на Швеция и Франция.

The purpose of the section is to promote the achievements of the young and active part of our society. / "Аз съм" е кратка портретна форма, която представя интересни и талантливи млади хора, изявяващи се в различни области – спортисти, артисти, художници, певци. programme.title: Frankfurt - Tottenham, Football, Europa League / Frankfurt - Tottenham, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Velik broj klubova je uključen u proces kvalifikacija te prvi susreti počinju već krajem lipnja. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.sub-title: Was, wenn jemand die Sonne abdunkelt?
programme.desc: In some countries on earth, he has already started the race for the best technical answer to climate change. Science journalist Lena Ganschow goes in search of traces. How much potential for conflict is in geo-engineering when people try to influence the weather and climate? In Abu Dhabi, weather is no longer wishful, but long a government program. The United Arab Emirates belong to the driest countries of the earth. At the national center for meteorology, one does not manage to observe this state. On the contrary: Here you can keep out for clouds that can be wrapped to wrestle down a little more rain to the sky. "Cloud Seeding" is the name of this technique, in which salt particles are sprayed in the cloud to create raindrops. Dander in the region have already played similar programs in order not to fall behind the tight resource of water. The fear also resonates, the neighbor could "take away" the rain clouds. In 2018, the Iranian Brigadier general Gholam Reza Jalali clearly pronounced when he accused Israel and other countries of wanting to take the rain clouds away from his country. "We need governance," says Dr. Abdullah Mandous, Prasident of the International Meteorological Institute (WMO). In order to avoid conflicts, clear regulations are needed for the cloud seeding.The geo-engineering can also have a safety-political component, its story shows. In 1962 the US military started a project under the name Stormfury. It was an attempt to weaken hurricanes by inserting silver iodide into the clouds. From 1967 to 1972, the US Airforce sprouted daily lead and silver iodide powder in monsoon clouds with the aim of strengthening rain traps during the secret operation Popeye in order to interrupt the post-drawers of the Vietcong. is. Because clouds are complex and not yet well understood in detail, as a visit to the Swiss research station in Erisiwil shows. There, meteorologists from ETH Zurich are developing new methods to research the development of precipitation. To do this, test a weather balloon that can be observed in the cloud, as is the case with the Cloud Seeding ice crystals ice crystals grow around the smallest particles. This is still basic research. Lands like the United Arab Emirates are trading long. Researchers around Ulrike Lohmann consider this development with concern. They warn of possible unpleasant consequences - both for politics and FUR climate. Above all, those methods that cannot only influence the local weather, but potentially the global climate are discussed. Es war ein Versuch, Hurrikane zu schwachen, indem man Silberjodid in die Wolken einbrachte. Von 1967 bis 1972 verspruhte die US-Airforce wahrend des Vietnamkrieges im Rahmen der geheimen Operation Popeye taglich Blei- und Silberjodidpulver in Monsunwolken mit dem Ziel, Regenfalle zu verstarken, um die Nachschublinien des Vietcongs auf dem Ho-Chi-Minh-Pfad zu unterbrechen.Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler bezweifeln allerdings, ob die Methode wirklich wirksam ist. programme.desc: These six people could hardly be more different, but the stress of her everyday life has been combined: the teacher Silvia (Stefanie Stappenbeck) has to come up with two children as a single mother and is now also plagued by a tinnitus in addition to money worries; The restless management consultant Johann (Max von Pufendorf) leads a life in the fast lane and sees every break as a wasted time; The publisher Alfred (Martin Brambach) has been unemployed for years and, after over 500 unsuccessful applications, humiliating temporary positions and frustrating appointments in the job center threatens to lose any courage to live; The young Rosa (Paula Kalenberg) is shining in a chic advertising agency from a badly paid internship and has no real perspective despite her burning ambition; Conversely, the newly baked pensioner Herbert (Walter Kreye) can look at a fully experienced professional life: he has accompanied people to death in a hospice for 40 years; Therefore, he knows about the finiteness of life and still liked many dreams and wishes. Unfortunately, his wife Gudrun (Jutta Speidel), who goes through life full of pessimism and for which every day only means one further step towards death. They have all gathered more or less voluntarily in a remote forest hotel in Markic Switzerland in order to find their mental balance far away from the hectic big city. However, Johann and Gudrun in particular are very willing to face their problems. It is also not easy for the other participants to leave everyday life behind. None of them still suspects which tricks and tricks the experienced therapist Hannah (Birge Schade) came up with to lure the illustrious troops out of the reserve. In strenuous hikes and camping nights in the middle of the forest, the stressed city should find themselves. But unfortunately, group therapy does not go as smoothly and stress -free as planned in the green. Soon the therapist Hannah no longer knows where her head is. / Diese sechs Menschen konnten unterschiedlicher kaum sein, aber der Stress ihres alltaglichen Lebens hat sie zusammengefuhrt: Die Lehrerin Silvia (Stefanie Stappenbeck) muss sich als alleinerziehende Mutter um zwei Kinder kummern und wird neben Geldsorgen nun auch von einem Tinnitus geplagt; der rastlose Unternehmensberater Johann (Max von Pufendorf) fuhrt ein Leben auf der Überholspur und betrachtet jede Pause als vergeudete Zeit; der Verlagslektor Alfred (Martin Brambach) wiederum ist seit Jahren arbeitslos und droht nach uber 500 erfolglosen Bewerbungen, demutigenden Aushilfsstellen und frustrierenden Terminen im Jobcenter jeden Lebensmut zu verlieren; die junge Rosa (Paula Kalenberg) hangelt sich in einer schicken Werbeagentur von einem mies bezahlten Praktikumsvertrag zum nachsten und hat trotz ihres brennenden Ehrgeizes keine echte Perspektive; umgekehrt kann der frischgebackene Rentner Herbert (Walter Kreye) auf ein erfulltes Berufsleben zuruckblicken: Er hat 40 Jahre lang Menschen in einem Hospiz in den Tod begleitet; daher weiSS er um die Endlichkeit des Lebens und mochte sich noch viele Traume und Wunsche erfullen. Ganz anders leider seine Frau Gudrun (Jutta Speidel), die voller Pessimismus durchs Leben geht und fur die jeder Tag nur einen weiteren Schritt in Richtung Tod bedeutet. Sie alle haben sich mehr oder weniger freiwillig in einem abgelegenen Waldhotel in der Markischen Schweiz eingefunden, um fern der hektischen GroSSstadt ihr seelisches Gleichgewicht wiederzufinden. Allerdings sind vor allem Johann und Gudrun wenig gewillt, sich ihren Problemen zu stellen. Auch den anderen Teilnehmern fallt es nicht leicht, den Alltag hinter sich zu lassen. Noch ahnt keiner von ihnen, welche Tricks und Kniffe sich die erfahrene Therapeutin Hannah (Birge Schade) ausgedacht hat, um die illustre Truppe aus der Reserve zu locken. Bei anstrengenden Wanderungen und Camping-Nachten mitten im Wald sollen die gestressten Stadter zu sich selbst finden. Aber ganz so reibungslos und stressfrei wie geplant verlauft die Gruppentherapie im Grunen leider doch nicht. Bald weiSS die Therapeutin Hannah vor lauter Chaos selbst nicht mehr, wo ihr der Kopf steht.

In the east of Europe, the greatest landscapes of the continent, wisente, ensure a healthy forest in which they create clearings. In Finland, the Bartkauz nautonously chases over the snow, while brownish and wolf compete for food. Waldbrande ensure renewal in Portugal, but can also have catastrophic consequences for forest dwellers. Spruce bark cafers that affect Baume in Central Europe also cause great damage. But here too, nature knows how to produce new things from destruction. Fascination Europe: A unique series about the many natural wonder of Europe from the award -winning director Christian Baumeister. / Von den weiSSen Wunderwelten im eisigen Norden, in dem Eisbaren, Wale und Bartkauze der klirrenden Kalte trotzen, bis weit in den warmen Suden, wo die spektakularen Landschaften Schleichkatzen, Flamingos und Berberaffen Ruckzugsorte bieten: Die UNIVERSUM-Serie FASZINATION EUROPA liefert neue Einblicke in die erstaunlichen, vielfaltigen Naturwelten unseres Kontinents. Die Folge GEHEIMNISVOLLE WÄLDER bietet bewegende Einblicke in einen faszinierenden Lebensraum, in dem Tiere ganz besondere Fahigkeiten beweisen und die Walder selbst sich immer wieder neu erfinden. Im Osten Europas sorgen die groSSten Landsaugetiere des Kontinents, Wisente, fur einen gesunden Wald, in dem sie Lichtungen schaffen. programme.title: Remark times! - Johann-Philipps Castle visits / Herrschaftszeiten! - Johann-Philipps Schlossbesuche
programme.sub-title: Bei Familie Liechtenstein auf der Riegersburg
programme.desc: This time Johann-Philipp Spiegelfeld visits the elevated Riegersburg in the Styrian Vulkanland and its residents, the Liechtenstein family. The Riegersburg is located 10 kilometers north -east of Feldbach, was first mentioned in 1138, has 108 rooms to 3900 m² and has been owned by the Liechtenstein family since 1822. Here the inquisitive visitors experience a lot of stories again - both about the amgious Gemauer and their owner. This time there are also truly adventurous high points, such as an encounter with the impressive birds of prey, which are of particular importance for the professional pilots, and a spectacular and sporting end of the visit, which Johann-Philipp had not expected in advance. / Diesmal besucht Johann-Philipp Spiegelfeld die beruhmte Riegersburg im Steirischen Vulkanland und ihre BewohnerInnen, Familie Liechtenstein. Die Riegersburg liegt 10 Kilometer nordostlich von Feldbach, wurde 1138 erstmals urkundlich erwahnt, hat 108 Zimmer auf 3900 m² und ist seit 1822 im Besitz der Familie Liechtenstein. Hier erfahrt der wissbegierige Besucher wieder eine Menge Geschichten - sowohl uber die ehrwurdigen Gemauer als auch deren Eigentumer. Diesmal gibt es auch wahrhaft abenteuerliche Hohepunkte, wie zum Beispiel eine Begegnung mit den imposanten Greifvogeln, die fur den Berufspiloten eine besondere Bedeutung haben, und einen spektakularen und sportlichen Abschluss des Besuchs, mit dem Johann-Philipp vorab nicht gerechnet hatte.

programme.desc: They remember the last indigenous people who live completely isolated from the other world on an island: the Sentinelese. Despite a strict ban, the American Free Church Missionary John Chau wants to contact the people in order to convert it to the Christian faith. His attempted mission ends for him. With archive recordings from John's trip to North Sentinel and with his detailed diary records, this documentary illuminates, among other things, the problematic missionary understanding of his evangelical community. / Sie gehoren zu den letzen indigenen Volkern, die vollig isoliert von der ubrigen Welt auf einer Insel leben: die Sentinelesen. Der US-amerikanische freikirchliche Missionar John Chau will trotz eines strikten Verbots mit dem Volk Kontakt aufnehmen, um es zum christlichen Glauben zu bekehren. Sein Missionsversuch endet fur ihn todlich. Mit Archivaufnahmen von Johns Reise nach North Sentinel und mit seinen ausfuhrlichen Tagebuchaufzeichnungen beleuchtet dieser Dokumentarfilm unter anderem das problematische Missionsverstandnis seiner evangelikalen Gemeinschaft.

programme.title: Maria Theresia - Teil 4 / Maria Theresia - Teil 4
programme.desc: Maria Theresia acts in her bitterness. Her jealousy on Franz made her suspicious. It prescribes strict Catholicism to the court. Her secret police attacks the jaw game and thus also Franz's business interests, who runs a excessive love life. At least the glow of war turns to Maria Theresa's favor. Her army marches on Prague. Unexpectedly, something happens that Maria Theresia's life is based on its foundations. She finds a secret love and thus also a new problem. / Maria Theresia wirkt in ihrer Verbitterung gealtert. Ihre Eifersucht auf Franz hat sie misstrauisch gemacht. Sie verordnet dem Hof einen strengen Katholizismus. Ihre Geheimpolizei attackiert das Glucksspiel und damit auch die Geschaftsinteressen von Franz, der ein ausschweifendes Liebesleben fuhrt. Zumindest das Kriegsgluck wendet sich zu Maria Theresias Gunsten. Ihre Armee marschiert auf Prag. Unerwartet geschieht etwas, das Maria Theresias Leben in seinen Grundfesten erschuttert. Sie findet eine heimliche Liebe und damit auch ein neues Problem.

programme.title: Remark times! - Johann-Philipps Castle visits / Herrschaftszeiten! - Johann-Philipps Schlossbesuche
programme.sub-title: Bei Familie Liechtenstein auf der Riegersburg
programme.desc: This time Johann-Philipp Spiegelfeld visits the elevated Riegersburg in the Styrian Vulkanland and its residents, the Liechtenstein family. The Riegersburg is located 10 kilometers north -east of Feldbach, was first mentioned in 1138, has 108 rooms to 3900 m² and has been owned by the Liechtenstein family since 1822. Here the inquisitive visitors experience a lot of stories again - both about the amgious Gemauer and their owner. This time there are also truly adventurous high points, such as an encounter with the impressive birds of prey, which are of particular importance for the professional pilots, and a spectacular and sporting end of the visit, which Johann-Philipp had not expected in advance. / Diesmal besucht Johann-Philipp Spiegelfeld die beruhmte Riegersburg im Steirischen Vulkanland und ihre BewohnerInnen, Familie Liechtenstein. Die Riegersburg liegt 10 Kilometer nordostlich von Feldbach, wurde 1138 erstmals urkundlich erwahnt, hat 108 Zimmer auf 3900 m² und ist seit 1822 im Besitz der Familie Liechtenstein. Hier erfahrt der wissbegierige Besucher wieder eine Menge Geschichten - sowohl uber die ehrwurdigen Gemauer als auch deren Eigentumer. Diesmal gibt es auch wahrhaft abenteuerliche Hohepunkte, wie zum Beispiel eine Begegnung mit den imposanten Greifvogeln, die fur den Berufspiloten eine besondere Bedeutung haben, und einen spektakularen und sportlichen Abschluss des Besuchs, mit dem Johann-Philipp vorab nicht gerechnet hatte.

programme.title: Fascination Europe (3) - mysterious forest / Faszination Europa (3) - Geheimnisvolle Walder

programme.title: Land and people / Land und Leute
programme.desc: Wildlays protecting for harvesting time in the dangerous harvest time from July to October by the hunts and farmers, "country and people" shows the example of the Jagdrevier Grossharras in the Weinviertel in Lower Easter. The harvest time is associated with stress and dangers for wild animals, not least because the efficient harvesting machines cover and shading often gone in one fell swoop. The search for food is also more difficult because there are hardly any backstone in the fields. This also lurks for a sustainable prey. It is the time of the so -called harvest shock, which particularly hits the low -rarely such as partrid, pheasants or rabbits. In the Grossharras hunting district, farmers with support from the Lower Austria Hunting Association of Interference are planted on the harvested fields, already laid out for new shelter in the spring or bushes or secure water areas. Dry climate and the hot summers as ideal for lavender cultivation, shows a report in Stronegg. Young farmers have discovered lavender as a crop and process their lavender primarily into oil. Ergotherapy at Hofam Rohrberghof, a green care company in Sudsteiermark, can immerse yourself in the country's life. Dealing with the animals and the common hay work addresses all the senses, demand fine motor skills and the coexistence in the Styria -different wine festivals will soon attract many visitors again in Styria, at the same time the winemakers, for example in the Grossklein area, can get a pathogen to the whole vineyard. Cutting flower manufacturer Doris Bistricky in Steyr in Oberosterreich successful. As a member of the Slowflower movement, she produces diverse flower varieties, regionally and free of pesticides. / Wildtiere schutzen zur ErntezeitWie Wildtiere in der fur sie gefahrvollen Erntezeit von Juli bis Oktober durch die Jagerschaft und Landwirte geschutzt werden, zeigt "Land und Leute" am Beispiel des Jagdreviers GroSSharras im Weinviertel in Niederosterreich. Die Erntezeit ist fur Wildtiere mit Stress und Gefahren verbunden, nicht zuletzt, weil durch die effizienten Erntemaschinen Deckung und Beschattung oft mit einem Schlag weg sind. Auch die Futtersuche gestaltet sich schwieriger, weil es kaum Ruckstande auf den Feldern gibt. Dadurch lauern auch verstarkt Beutegreifer. Es ist die Zeit des sogenannten Ernteschocks, der besonders das Niederwild wie Rebhuhner, Fasane oder Hasen trifft. Im Jagdrevier GroSSharras werden von Landwirten mit Unterstutzung des NÖ Landesjagdverbandes Zwischenfruchte auf den abgeernteten Äckern gepflanzt, im Fruhling bereits Brachflachen und Strauchreihen fur neue Unterschlupfe angelegt oder sichere Wasserstellen angelegt.Weitere Themen von "Land und Leute" am 9. August:Lavendel aus dem WeinviertelDas Weinviertel erweist sich mit seinen kargen Boden, dem trockenen Klima und den heiSSen Sommern als ideal fur den Lavendelanbau, zeigt eine Reportage in Stronegg. Junge Landwirte haben Lavendel als Kulturpflanze fur sich entdeckt und verarbeiten ihren Lavendel vor allem zu Öl.Ergotherapie am HofAm Rohrberghof, einem Green Care-Betrieb in der Sudsteiermark, konnen behinderte Kinder ins Landleben eintauchen. Der Umgang mit den Tieren und die gemeinsame Heuarbeit sprechen alle Sinne an, fordern Feinmotorik und das Miteinander.Weinbau in der SteiermarkUnterschiedliche Weinfeste ziehen in der Steiermark schon bald wieder viele Besucher an, gleichzeitig kampfen die Winzer etwa im Raum GroSSklein gegen die Rebzikade, die einen Erreger ubertragt, dem ganze Weingarten zum Opfer fallen.Blumen frisch vom HofBluten und Blumen von den eigenen Feldern, damit ist Schnittblumenbauerin Doris Bistricky in Steyr in Oberosterreich erfolgreich. Als Mitglied der Slowflower Bewegung produziert sie vielfaltige Blumensorten, regional und frei von Pestiziden.

programme.title: The taste of Europe / Der Geschmack Europas
programme.desc: This time Lojze Wieser and Martin Traxl explore the Alentejo, one of the most attractive areas of Portugal on their foray through European regions and their cakes. The Alentejo, who borders Algarve in the Suden, is the largest region of Portugal and comprises around a third of the country. Natural treasure-from the wild-romantic Atlantic custody to the cork oak walls in Alentejische Hinterland. The centuries-long influence of the Moors, Arabs, Romer and Christians not only reflect in architecture and folk culture, but also left their traces in the culinary and cake of the Alentejos. On their journey from Évora, Marvao, MonSaraz Estremoz find Lojze Wieser and Martin Traxl the taste of the cultures mixed over the centuries and encounter people who can transfer the old recipes to today. / Diesmal erkunden Lojze Wieser und Martin Traxl auf ihrem Streifzug durch europaische Regionen und deren Kuchen den Alentejo, eine der reizvollsten Gegenden Portugals.Der Alentejo, der im Suden an die viel besuchte Algarve grenzt, ist flachenmaSSig die groSSte Region Portugals und umfasst rund ein Drittel des Landes.Gleichzeitig ist der Alentejo aber auch die am dunnsten besiedelte Region und ein wahrer Naturschatz - von der wild-romantischen Atlantikkuste bis zu den Korkeichen-Waldern im alentejischen Hinterland.Die jahrhundertelangen Einflusse der Mauren, Araber, Romer und Christen spiegeln sich nicht nur in der Architektur und Volkskultur wider, sondern haben auch ihre Spuren in der Kulinarik und Kuche des Alentejos hinterlassen.Auf ihrer Reise von Évora, Marvao, Monsaraz bis nach Estremoz finden Lojze Wieser und Martin Traxl die Geschmacker der durch die Jahrhunderte vermengten Kulturen und begegnen Menschen, die die alten Rezepte ins Heute ubertragen konnen.

Das geht ihm auf die Nerven, er stellt den Beschatter, der ihm wiederum sein Leid klagt uber seinen Beruf. Die beiden treffen ein Abkommen, Roda wolle ihm freiwillig erzahlen, wohin er sich begibt, was er tut und gibt ihm sogar Tipps, wie der Detektiv seine Berichte besser verfasse, wodurch er ihm - wie es sich Jahre spater herausstellt - zum Aufstieg bei seiner Karrriere.4. "Die Flamme aus Ohio". Ein junger, biederer Mann verliebt sich in eine Amerikanerin, die sich in Wien nicht auskennt. Seine aus Verlegenheit und Verliebtheit bedingte Schusselei ruft ziemliche Verwirrungen und Verwicklungen hervor. Da er ofter den falschen Schirm mitnimmt, glaubt sie, sein Hobby sei Stehlen. Und als er ihr einen Verlobungsring schenkt, ist es fur sie klar, dass auch der nicht gekauft sein konne- und stiehlt fur ihn eine Krawattennadel.DarstellerInnen: Robert Dietl, Adi Lukan, Werner Prinz, Alexander Riff, Fritz Muliar, Marianne Chappuis, Maria Perschy, Peter Gerhard, Peter Faerber, Ariane Calix, Doris Pascher, Kristina Walter, Peter Weck, Erich Padalewski, Franzi Lippert, Alfons Haider, Leslie Malton, Waltraut Haas, Fritz Dietrich, Karl Schwetter.

programme.desc: August and Nancy learn from a broker that the purchase of their garden house is zero and void because the property was not in the possession of Vysloczil. Claudia besucht mit ihrem Freund ihre Eltern, und insbesondere ihr Vater lasst dabei kaum eine Gelegenheit aus, ins sprichwortliche Fettnapchen zu treten. programme.title: Rosa Roth / Rosa Roth
programme.desc: "The day will come". It is confronted with a case that is bigger and more exciting than anything she has so far. Rosa Roth, alone against the rest of the world. In a Berlin airport toilet, a suitcase with previously unknown cartridges made of plastic is found, which makes the security organs highly alert. This ammunition can neither a metal detector nor an explosive dog, and above all: there must be a corresponding weapon. Who has it and where and when should it be used? Rosa Roth takes up the fight against crazy opponents. Central figures in this game on life and death are Michael Katzmann (Sylvester Groth), a convicted serious criminal who has an open bill with Rosa Roth, the Amsterdam weapon handler Willem Van Kleve (Mario Adorf) and the Arab Nabil (Ingo Hulsmann), who lives in Paris, who is striving for a reorganization of the world. Rosa Roth has no idea what tarpaulin you are pursuing and what crimes you prepare. Within a short time, she is on the verge of the abyss professionally and privately. The events continue to come up with: Iris Berben, Mario Adorf, Ulrich Tukur, Jasmin Tabatabai, Anneke Kim Sarnau, Sylvester Groth, Ingo Hulsmann, Alexander Held, etc. Regie: Carlo Rolade 2007 / "Der Tag wird kommen" erzahlt von den hartesten sechs Tagen in der bisherigen Laufbahn der Kommissarin Rosa Roth. Sie wird mit einem Fall konfrontiert, der groSSer und spannender ist als alles, was sie bisher durchgemacht hat. Rosa Roth, allein gegen den Rest der Welt. In einer Berliner Flughafentoilette wird ein Koffer mit bisher unbekannten Patronen aus Kunststoff gefunden, der die Sicherheitsorgane in hochste Alarmbereitschaft versetzt. Diese Munition kann weder ein Metalldetektor noch ein Sprengstoffhund aufspuren, und vor allem: Es muss eine entsprechende Waffe dazu geben. Wer hat sie und wo und wann soll sie eingesetzt werden? Rosa Roth nimmt den Kampf gegen ubermachtige Gegner auf. Zentrale Figuren in diesem Spiel auf Leben und Tod sind Michael Katzmann (Sylvester Groth), ein verurteilter Schwerverbrecher, der eine offene Rechnungmit Rosa Roth hat, der Amsterdamer Waffenhandler Willem van Kleve (Mario Adorf) und der in Paris lebende Araber Nabil (Ingo Hulsmann), der eine Neuordnung der Welt anstrebt. Rosa Roth ahnt nicht, welche Plane sie verfolgen und welche Verbrechen sie vorbereiten. Innerhalb kurzester Zeit steht sie beruflich und privat am Rande des Abgrunds. Die Ereignisse spitzen sich von Tag zu Tag weiter zu.Mit: Iris Berben, Mario Adorf, Ulrich Tukur, Jasmin Tabatabai, Anneke Kim Sarnau,Sylvester Groth, Ingo Hulsmann, Alexander Held, u.a.Regie: Carlo RolaDE 2007

programme.title: Documentation "Herbert Prohaska: The Ball, A Life" / Dokumentation "Herbert Prohaska: Der Ball, ein Leben"
programme.desc: On the occasion of Herbert Prohaska's 70th birthday, "The Ball, a Life" traces the path of the jubilee from the Simmeringer community building to Austria's century footballer. Rarrings such as Toni Polster, Hans Krankl or Franz Wohlfahrt over their very special encounters with the "Schneckerl". In addition, "the ball, a life" extends like Herbert Prohaska on a European champion title and at a second team boss era at the ÖFB. / Anlasslich des 70. Geburtstags von Herbert Prohaska zeichnet "Der Ball, ein Leben" den Weg des Jubilars vom Simmeringer Gemeindebau zum Jahrhundertfussballer Österreichs nach. Weggefahrten wie Toni Polster, Hans Krankl oder Franz Wohlfahrt uber ihre ganz speziellen Begegnungen mit dem "Schneckerl". Dazu enthullt "Der Ball, ein Leben" wie knapp dran Herbert Prohaska an einem Europameister-Titel und an einer zweiten Teamchef-Ära beim ÖFB war.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans / Extraordinary Humans
programme.desc: Biologist Thom Hunt is looking for people with extraordinary super pounders worldwide who blow up the limits of the human body and spirit. From unbelievable memory absorbers to pain resistance and highly strong to record -compatible reflexes and breathing control - Thom meets people who seem to be impossible. He tests her seams, researches her world and shows what people can really do. / Biologe Thom Hunt sucht weltweit Menschen mit auSSergewohnlichen Superkraften, die die Grenzen des menschlichen Korpers und Geistes sprengen. Von unglaublichem Erinnerungsvermogen uber Schmerzresistenz und ubermenschliche Starke bis hin zu rekordverdachtigen Reflexen und Atemkontrolle - Thom begegnet Menschen, die scheinbar Unmogliches leisten. Er testet ihre Fahigkeiten, erforscht ihre Welt und zeigt, was der Mensch wirklich leisten kann.

programme.title: Storage Hunters / Storage Hunters
programme.desc: Storage space auctions are just fun? Not for Brandon Bernie and his wife Lori. The two trips from auction to auction - across the USA, always on the hunt for cheap snaps. Because in the United States, anyone, the storage room is required, can rent a "storage unit" and accommodate their private objects there. However, if the rent is not paid, the content is auctioned - and true treasures can hide in the storage rooms. Bernie and Lori want to get these treasures: they risk a lot, the competition with the locals is hard and the two are not given anything at the auctions. Is this always worthwhile - or do the opponents only want to drive the price into the high? / Lagerraum-Auktionen sind nur SpaSS? Nicht fur Brandon Bernie und seine Ehefrau Lori. Die beiden reisen von Auktion zu Auktion - quer durch die USA, immer auf der Jagd nach gunstigen Schnappchen. Denn in den USA kann jeder, der Lagerraum benotigt, eine "storage unit" anmieten und dort seine privaten Gegenstande unterbringen. Wird allerdings die Miete nicht gezahlt, kommt es zur Versteigerung des Inhalts - und in den Lagerraumen konnen sich wahre Schatze verstecken. Diese Schatze wollen Bernie und Lori ergattern: Sie riskieren viel, der Wettbewerb mit den einheimischen Mitbietern ist hart und die beiden bekommen bei den Auktionen nichts geschenkt. Ob sich dies immer lohnt - oder wollen die Kontrahenten nur den Preis in die Hohe treiben?

programme.title: Ryanair - The dark side of cheap flying / Ryanair - Die dunkle Seite des billigen Fliegens
programme.desc: Cheap and quickly to the dream destination: This is how Ryanair attracts customers. With its low-cost model, the Irish company is the high-flyer among the cheap airlines. But at what price? Flight attendant is considered a dream job, and Ryanair knows how to use this. However, the employees denounce unreasonable working conditions: small contents, pressure on on -board sales and tough management. Nevertheless, Ryanair is still in the fast lane. The French journalist Tom Cariou looks behind the scenes of Ryanair and researches the airport in France, Spain and England - partly with a hidden camera. How does the airline manage to sell tickets at cheap prices and at the same time to be the most profitable airline in Europe? The company's head, Michael Oleeary, relies on permanent reduction in costs and process optimization. Ryanair only operates Boeing machines with a maximum number of seats. The flights are almost always fully booked and the time on the ground is exactly calculated. In addition, there are strict guidelines for packaging, and everything on board is subject to a fee. Crew members describe the pressure when buying on board and individual requirements that have to be achieved. The good creating results are probably also based on this tough personnel policy. For years, SARE Michael Oleeary, he was more likely to chop on his right hand than to sign an agreement with the unions. But at the end of 2017 he discloses his opinion: Pilot strikes in Germany, Spain, Great Britain and Italy threaten. Ryanair is under pressure at the negotiating table and finally recognizes pilot unions as a negotiating partner - a signal to the cabin staff. This is also hoping for generally binding tariff orders across Europe. The employees on the Canary Islands are also affected by this. In January 2018, many of them organize themselves - a small revolution at Ryanair. This is followed by an unprecedented struggle for fair working conditions with a surprising outcome. The low -cost airline is still on the road to success and breaks over across Europe. Ryanair aims to ask 300 million passengers a year by 2034. / Gunstig und schnell ans Traumziel: So lockt Ryanair Kunden an. Das irische Unternehmen ist mit seinem Low-Cost-Modell der Überflieger unter den Billigairlines. Doch zu welchem Preis? Flugbegleiter gilt als Traumjob, und Ryanair weiSS das zu nutzen. Die Angestellten jedoch prangern unzumutbare Arbeitsbedingungen an: geringe Gehalter, Druck bei den Bordverkaufen und ein knallhartes Management. Dennoch ist Ryanair weiter auf der Überholspur. Der franzosische Journalist Tom Cariou blickt hinter die Kulissen von Ryanair und recherchiert an Flughafen in Frankreich, Spanien und England - teils mit versteckter Kamera. Wie schafft es die Fluggesellschaft, Tickets zu gunstigen Preisen zu verkaufen und gleichzeitig die profitabelste Airline Europas zu sein? Der Chef des Unternehmens, Michael OLeary, setzt auf permanente Kostensenkung und Prozessoptimierung. Ryanair betreibt ausschlieSSlich Boeing-Maschinen mit maximaler Anzahl von Sitzen. Die Fluge sind fast immer ausgebucht, und die Zeit am Boden ist exakt kalkuliert. Daruber hinaus gelten strenge Richtlinien fur Gepackzuschlage, und alles an Bord ist kostenpflichtig. Crewmitglieder schildern den Druck bei Bordverkaufen und individuellen Vorgaben, die erreicht werden mussen. Die guten Geschaftsergebnisse basieren wohl auch auf dieser knallharten Personalpolitik. Seit Jahren beschwort Michael OLeary, er wurde sich eher die rechte Hand abhacken, als eine Vereinbarung mit den Gewerkschaften zu unterzeichnen. Doch Ende 2017 andert er seine Meinung: Es drohen Pilotenstreiks in Deutschland, Spanien, GroSSbritannien und Italien. Unter Druck setzt sich Ryanair an den Verhandlungstisch und erkennt schlieSSlich Pilotengewerkschaften als Verhandlungspartner an - ein Signal an das Kabinenpersonal. Auch das hofft europaweit auf allgemeinverbindliche Tarifvertrage. Davon betroffen sind auch die Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter auf den Kanarischen Inseln. Im Januar 2018 organisieren sich viele von ihnen gewerkschaftlich - eine kleine Revolution bei Ryanair. Es folgt ein beispielloser Kampf um faire Arbeitsbedingungen mit uberraschendem Ausgang. Die Billigairline ist weiter auf Erfolgskurs und bricht europaweit samtliche Rekorde. Ryanair setzt sich zum Ziel, bis 2034 pro Jahr 300 Millionen Passagiere zu befordern.

programme.title: The time machine (e) / Η Μηχανή του Χρόνου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The story of Delos. The show travels to the most sacred island of antiquity, Delos and presents its countless treasures, many of whom were lost or forgotten over time. / Επεισόδιο: Η ιστορία της Δήλου. Η εκπομπή ταξιδεύει στο ιερότερο νησί της αρχαιότητας, τη Δήλο και παρουσιάζει τους αμέτρητους θησαυρούς της, πολλοί απ τους οποίους χάθηκαν ή ξεχάστηκαν μέσα στο χρόνο.

programme.title: We arrived! K2 E22 (E) / Φτάσαμε! Κ2 Ε22 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Heraklion - Lasithi. The broadcast trips we arrived with Jerome Kalouta continue in Crete, on an island endless in images, flavors, melodies, legends and folk traditions, starting with the distinctive Heraklion and lush Lasithi. / Επεισόδιο: Ηράκλειο - Λασίθι. Τα ταξίδια της εκπομπής Φτάσαμε με τον Ζερόμ Καλούτα συνεχίζονται στην Κρήτη, σε ένα νησί ανεξάντλητο σε εικόνες, γεύσεις, μελωδίες, θρύλους και λαϊκές παραδόσεις, με αφετηρία το ξεχωριστό Ηράκλειο και το καταπράσινο Λασίθι.

programme.title: Mom's cake K1 E19 (E) / Η Τούρτα της Μαμάς Κ1 Ε19 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Athens 2021, 1st Part. On the occasion of the undergraduate thesis of a classmate of Evanthia on the shooting of a short film at the Petralona house, all the tribes of Athens flock to taste the flavors of the hostess and their acting talent. / Επεισόδιο: Αθήνα 2021, 1ο Μέρος. Με αφορμή την πτυχιακή εργασία ενός συμμαθητή της Ευανθίας με θέμα το γύρισμα μιας ταινίας μικρού μήκους στο σπίτι των Πετραλώνων συρρέουν όλες οι φυλές της Αθήνας για να δοκιμάσουν τις γεύσεις της οικοδέσποινας και το υποκριτικό τους ταλέντο.

programme.title: Studio 4 (E) / Στούντιο 4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Nancy Zambetoglou and Thanassis Anagnostopoulos continue for the third season in the renewed and even richer daily magazine themes. / H Νάνσυ Ζαμπέτογλου και ο Θανάσης Αναγνωστόπουλος, συνεχίζουν για τρίτη σεζόν στο ανανεωμένο και ακόμη πιο πλούσιο σε θεματολογία καθημερινό μαγκαζίνο.

programme.title: Connections / Συνδέσεις
programme.desc: Kostas Papachlimintzos and Katerina Doukas are linked to Greece and the world and transmit what is happening and what concerns us and affects our daily lives. / Ο Κώστας Παπαχλιμίντζος και η Κατερίνα Δούκα συνδέονται με την Ελλάδα και τον κόσμο και μεταδίδουν ό,τι συμβαίνει και ό,τι μας αφορά και επηρεάζει την καθημερινότητά μας.

programme.title: The time machine (e) / Η Μηχανή του Χρόνου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Vassilis Avlonitis. The unknown life of the popular actor. His relatives, friends and actors tell stories of possession, incidents of films, talk about the unique improvisations he made and the grimaces with which the audience roused. / Επεισόδιο: Βασίλης Αυλωνίτης. Η άγνωστη ζωή του δημοφιλούς ηθοποιού. Συγγενικά του πρόσωπα, φίλοι αλλά και ηθοποιοί αφηγούνται ιστορίες από την Κατοχή, περιστατικά από ταινίες, μιλούν για τους μοναδικούς αυτοσχεδιασμούς που έκανε αλλά και τις γκριμάτσες με τις οποίες ξεσήκωνε το κοινό.

programme.title: Life otherwise K4 (e) / Η Ζωή Αλλιώς Κ4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Mani ... stone and olive. The show met many separate people, looking for the meaning of life in Mani, asking them about their lives, the position of love and love and the image of their historical homeland in their minds and hearts. / Επεισόδιο: Μάνη... Πέτρα και Ελιά. Η εκπομπή συνάντησε πολλούς ξεχωριστούς ανθρώπους, ψάχνοντας το νόημα της ζωής στη Μάνη, ρωτώντας τους για τις ζωές τους, για τη θέση της αγάπης και του έρωτα αλλά και την εικόνα της ιστορικής πατρίδας τους στο μυαλό και στην καρδιά τους.

programme.title: We arrived! K2 E23 (E) / Φτάσαμε! Κ2 Ε23 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Rethymnon. This time Jerome Kaluta browsing the prefecture of Rethymnon, an area with wild mountain peaks and exotic beaches, with authentic people and traditions that remain alive. / Επεισόδιο: Ρέθυμνο. Αυτή τη φορά ο Ζερόμ Καλούτα περιηγείται στον νομό Ρεθύμνου, μια περιοχή με άγριες ορεινές κορυφές και εξωτικές παραλίες, με αυθεντικούς ανθρώπους και παραδόσεις που παραμένουν ζωντανές.

programme.title: News - Sports - Weather / Ειδήσεις - Αθλητικά - Καιρός
programme.desc: Watch the latest developments at national and international level and find out on time and objectively on the important issues of the news from the ERT news team. / Παρακολουθήστε τις τελευταίες εξελίξεις σε εθνικό αλλά και διεθνές επίπεδο και ενημερωθείτε έγκαιρα και αντικειμενικά για τα σημαντικά ζητήματα της επικαιρότητας από την ειδησεογραφική ομάδα της ΕΡΤ.

programme.title: The satrap / Ο Σατράπης
programme.desc: A widowed man already twice, finds his teacher in his third wife. (84) / Ένας δύστροπος άντρας, χήρος ήδη δύο φορές, βρίσκει τον δάσκαλό του στην τρίτη του γυναίκα. (84)

programme.title: Star squares (e) / Τα Τετράγωνα των Αστέρων (Ε)
programme.desc: The popular 80s game that was loved by the public returns to ERT, with Emerald Karydis. Get ready for laughter, reversals and a lot of fun. / Το δημοφιλές τηλεπαιχνίδι των 80s που αγαπήθηκε από το κοινό, επιστρέφει στην ΕΡΤ, με τη Σμαράγδα Καρύδη. Ετοιμαστείτε για γέλιο, ανατροπές και πολύ κέφι.

programme.title: Studio 4 (E) / Στούντιο 4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Nancy Zambetoglou and Thanassis Anagnostopoulos continue for the third season in the renewed and even richer daily magazine themes. / H Νάνσυ Ζαμπέτογλου και ο Θανάσης Αναγνωστόπουλος, συνεχίζουν για τρίτη σεζόν στο ανανεωμένο και ακόμη πιο πλούσιο σε θεματολογία καθημερινό μαγκαζίνο.

programme.title: Analytical News Release - Sports - Weather / Αναλυτικό Δελτίο Ειδήσεων - Αθλητικά - Καιρός
programme.desc: With correspondents in every corner of Greece and around the world, ERT's detailed news release brings to every home everyday reporting, extraordinary news, and what affects our lives. / Με ανταποκριτές σε κάθε γωνιά της Ελλάδας και σε όλο τον κόσμο το αναλυτικό δελτίο ειδήσεων της ΕΡΤ μεταφέρει σε κάθε σπίτι το καθημερινό ρεπορτάζ, τις έκτακτες ειδήσεις, αλλά και όσα επηρεάζουν τη ζωή μας.

programme.title: The adventures of Hercules Poirot K6 E2 (E) / Οι Περιπέτειες του Ηρακλή Πουαρό Κ6 Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Kleptomania Case. Miss Lemon persuades the inspector Poiro to investigate a series of microcosms in a student home when the case of simple kleptomania turns into an incomprehensible homicide. / Επεισόδιο: Υπόθεση Κλεπτομανίας. Η δεσποινίδα Λέμον πείθει τον Επιθεωρητή Πουαρό να ερευνήσει μια σειρά μικροκλοπών σε μια φοιτητική εστία όταν η υπόθεση απλής κλεπτομανίας μετατρέπεται σε ακατανόητη ανθρωποκτονία.

programme.title: Maria who became Callas E1 (E) / Η Μαρία που Έγινε Κάλλας Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: La Paloma. Athens, Spring 1937. Maria, Litsa and Jackie arrive by boat from New York in the port of Piraeus. In Athens, the three women encounter insurmountable difficulties. Litsa pushes Maria to participate in the La Paloma audition. / Επεισόδιο: La Paloma. Αθήνα,Ανοιξη 1937. Η Μαρία, η Λίτσα κι η Τζάκι φτάνουν με το πλοίο από τη Νέα Υόρκη στο λιμάνι του Πειραιά. Στην Αθήνα, οι τρεις γυναίκες συναντούν ανυπέρβλητες δυσκολίες. Η Λίτσα πιέζει τη Μαρία να συμμετάσχει στην οντισιόν La Paloma.

programme.title: Mom's cake K1 E20 (E) / Η Τούρτα της Μαμάς Κ1 Ε20 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Athens 2021 B Part. The clouds of explosive coexistence, Christians, all -religious, Greeks, Germans, Jews, rich, poor, gay, straight, pro -royal, blacks have begun to thicken and the first stages have watered the table with fish. / Επεισόδιο: Αθήνα 2021 Β Μέρος. Τα σύννεφα της εκρηκτικής συνύπαρξης, χριστιανών, αλλόθρησκων, Ελλήνων, Γερμανών, Εβραίων, πλουσίων, φτωχών, γκέι, στρέιτ, φιλοβασιλικών, μαύρων έχουν αρχίσει να πυκνώνουν και οι πρώτες στάλες έχουν ποτίσει το τραπέζι με την ψαροφαγία.

programme.title: Contact / Εξ Επαφής
programme.desc: Two couples of young people in an existential crisis, trying to solve not only the problems in their bond, but also the problems of each with themselves. The situation will become even more complicated when one couple's wife creates a love affair with the other couple's husband. (110) / Δυο ζευγάρια νέων ανθρώπων σε υπαρξιακή κρίση, που προσπαθούν να λύσουν όχι μόνο τα προβλήματα στο δεσμό τους, αλλά και τα προβλήματα καθενός με τον εαυτό του. Γνωρίστε το χρονικό της ένταξής τους!

programme.title: Islands on the edge of E2 / Νησιά στην Άκρη Ε2
programme.desc: Episode: Pserimos. A small island on the edge of the Aegean, between Kalymnos, Kos and Imia. With low hills and small valleys but inhabitants proud, strong. programme.title: Therapeutic Gardens E10 / Θεραπευτικοί Κήποι Ε10

programme.desc: Episode: A touch of freedom-egypt. programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Crete - West Coast. Μετά τα Χανιά, ο Πίτερ Μανέας κατευθύνεται στα ορεινά, όπου μαθαίνει για τη γεωλογική ιστορία του νησιού, ενώ δεν χάνει την ευκαιρία να πεζοπορήσει στο φαράγγι της Σαμαριάς. Στη συνέχεια, επισκέπτεται κάποια γειτονικά νησάκια.

programme.title: The wild islands of Ireland E1 (E) / Τα Άγρια Νησιά της Ιρλανδίας Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Wild Life of Winter. We spend the winter and early spring on the west coast. We watch the deer fighting in the windswept Inisbikelon, welcome the seal newborns amidst thunderstorms. / Επεισόδιο: Η Άγρια Ζωή του Χειμώνα. Περνάμε τον χειμώνα και τις αρχές της άνοιξης στη δυτική ακτή. Παρακολουθούμε τα ελάφια να μάχονται στο ανεμοδαρμένο Ινισβικελόν, καλωσορίζουμε τα νεογνά φώκιας εν μέσω καταιγίδων.

programme.title: The beauty of rust E3 (e) / Η Ομορφιά της Σκουριάς Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Military Machines: Farewell to arms. Lovers of history and cultural heritage, collectors, artists and urban explorers, who enjoy visits to abandoned places, join forces to maintain military dwarfs. / Επεισόδιο: Στρατιωτικές Μηχανές: Αποχαιρετισμός στα Όπλα. Οι λάτρεις της ιστορίας και της πολιτιστικής κληρονομιάς, οι συλλέκτες, οι καλλιτέχνες και οι αστικοί εξερευνητές, που απολαμβάνουν τις επισκέψεις σε εγκαταλειμμένα μέρη, ενώνουν τις δυνάμεις τους για τη διατήρηση στρατιωτικών κουφαριών.

programme.title: Balkans Express (ε) / Balkan Express (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Tirana, Albania. We travel to Tirana, the capital of Albania that is constantly changing. We tour Skenderbei Square and the Bloc district and descend to an underground nuclear shelter, which now functions as a museum and gallery. / Επεισόδιο: Τίρανα, Αλβανία. Ταξιδεύουμε στα Τίρανα, την πρωτεύουσα της Αλβανίας που αλλάζει συνεχώς. Περιηγούμαστε στην πλατεία Σκεντέρμπεη και τη συνοικία Μπλόκου και κατεβαίνουμε σε ένα υπόγειο πυρηνικό καταφύγιο, που πλέον λειτουργεί ως μουσείο και γκαλερί.

programme.title: It's up to you E3 (e) / Είναι στο Χέρι σου Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Ilenia and Stefanos continue their constructions in their new home and welcome Marilena Father (The Tidy Guru), to learn ways to better organize different spaces. / Η Ιλένια και ο Στέφανος συνεχίζουν τις κατασκευές στο καινούργιο σπίτι τους και υποδέχονται την Μαριλένα Πατέρα (The Tidy Guru), για να μάθουν τρόπους για το πως θα οργανώσουν καλύτερα τους διάφορους χώρους.

programme.title: Beautiful Italy E1 (E) / Όμορφη Ιταλία Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The warmth of the earth. The story of Bal Di Chechina has deep roots in geothermal energy and its use dates from 300 BC. Today, the community continues to exploit this resource for district heating, tourism and businesses. / Επεισόδιο: Η Θέρμη της Γης. Η ιστορία της Βαλ ντι Τσέτσινα έχει βαθιές ρίζες στη γεωθερμική ενέργεια και η χρήση της χρονολογείται από το 300 π.Χ. Σήμερα, η κοινότητα συνεχίζει να αξιοποιεί αυτόν τον πόρο για την τηλεθέρμανση, τον τουρισμό και τις επιχειρήσεις.

programme.title: The wild flock / O Bando Selvagem

É justo dizer que atividades como pilhagem, assassínio e roubo ocorrem no mundo natural? Quem sao os assassinos mais mortíferos, os assaltantes mais habilidosos, os mais fáceis de enfrentar e os mais agressivos?

programme.title: PSG vs Internazionale - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 Final / PSG vs Internazionale - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 Final
programme.desc: This is the first ever competitive meeting between Inter and Paris SG. programme.title: Mothers champions / Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. programme.title: Football - Champions League / Fudbal - Liga šampiona
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, the annual continental competition in which only the champions of their states are performed. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became a television the most watched football event on the planet. The most conquered titles of the Champions of Europe has Madrid Giant Real. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: The Best of / Košarka - Euroleague: The Best of
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Košarka: NBA - The Best of / Košarka: NBA - The Best of
programme.desc: The sixth day of June of June 1946. years will change the basketball game forever. On that day in New York, the most elite world basketball competition, the NBA league was founded. 29 Teams from the US and one from Canada Each autumn begins the hunt for the legendary ring intended for the Champions of the NBA league. The teams are divided into an east and western conference and through 82 regular season, the regular season hunting one of the eight playoff positions. Conference champions are entering the large NBA final where in a series of a maximum of seven games decide on the new champion. The NBA final is one of the most accurate sports events of the year that delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna meseca davne 1946. godine zauvek će promeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gde u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.
