programme.title: Hockey - KHL: tractor - Dynamo MSK, PF2 G2 / Hokej - KHL: Traktor - Dynamo Msk, PF2 G2
programme.desc: The strongest hockey hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called KHL or a continental hockey league. Only the competition was created from the Russian Super League in 2008. And since then the competition is spreading to increasingly European and Asian countries and thus becomes an unofficial other Hockey League of the world after the American-Canadian NLA. At the end of the season, the winner of the KHL Plejofa received a prestigious Gagarin Cup, while the best placed the Russian team wins the title of Russia Champions. Since 2011. The League except the clubs from the former USSR includes clubs from Central Europe, while since 2016. One Chinese representative enters first. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga sveta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa. Na kraju sezone pobednik KHL plejofa dobija prestižni Gagarin Kup, dok najbolje plasirana Ruska ekipa osvaja titulu šampiona Rusije. Od 2011. ligu osim klubova iz bivšeg SSSR-a ulaze klubovi iz centralne Evrope, dok od 2016. po prvi put ulazi i jedan Kineski predstavnik.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Široki Brijeg - Velež / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Široki Brijeg - Velež
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Montenegrin League: Future - Sutjeska / Fudbal - Crnogorska liga: Budućnost - Sutjeska
programme.desc: The Montenegrin football league was founded in 2004. years but the first season was played in 2006/2007. after the independence of the state. 12 Clubs in a three-round system of the competition struggled for the title of the champion, which finally won Zeta from Golubovac, which was the only title of the Champions of Montenegro. Today's number of clubs has been reduced to 10 and plays 30 cars. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Igokea - Cedevita Oimpija / Košarka - ABA liga: Igokea - Cedevita Oimpija
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.desc: The champions handball league has since 1955. year when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. programme.title: Blind / Bonanza
programme.desc: The Bonanza series is happening around 1860 in Nevada.Ben Cartwright, along with three sons, lives on the Ranch Ponderosa near the city of Virginia City off the coast of Lake Tahoe. / Serija Bonanza se dogaja okoli leta 1860 v Nevadi.Ben Cartwright skupaj s tremi sinovi živi na ranču Ponderosa v bližini mesta Virginia City ob obali jezera Tahoe.

programme.title: Dynasty / Dinastija
programme.desc: The mighty oil mogul Blake Carrington is preparing for a wedding with Young KRYSTLE JENNINGS, his former secretary. The Black KRYSTLE family accepts cold, and the staff also look at it, and Black's stubborn and promiscuous daughter resent her. Although he is committed to Krystle, Blake spends a lot more time and attention to his company Denver-Carrington, so he doesn't even notice what Krystle is facing. Her only ally is Blak's son, Steven, who, however, does not understand with her father, because of his different political views. / Mogočen naftni mogotec Blake Carrington se pripravlja na poroko z mlado Krystle Jennings, svojo nekdanjo tajnico. Blakova družina Krystle sprejme hladno, tudi osebje nanjo gleda zviška, Blakova trmasta in promiskuitetna hči pa ji zameri. Čeprav je predan Krystle, Blake veliko več časa in pozornosti namenja svojemu podjetju Denver-Carrington, zato niti ne opazi, s čim vse se Krystle sooča. Njen edini zaveznik je Blakov sin, Steven, ki pa se z očetom, zaradi različnih političnih pogledov, ne razume najbolje.

programme.title: CAPSULE / Kapsula
programme.desc: The capsule show features the latest fashion trends for young people and young people at heart. programme.title: Chat by coffee / Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. In each show, they address several topical topics that relate to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are at the same time researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and contemporary approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in each show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experience and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Celje people grind everything in front of them, the visit of the Muras should not be able to give them too much of a stock, but maybe knowing the fatigue due to European appearances. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Celjani meljejo vse pred seboj, obisk Murašev jim ne bi smel predstavljati prevelikega zalogaja, a morda se zna poznati utrujenost zaradi evropskih nastopov.Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: The Celje people grind everything in front of them, the visit of the Muras should not be able to give them too much of a stock, but maybe knowing the fatigue due to European appearances. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Celjani meljejo vse pred seboj, obisk Murašev jim ne bi smel predstavljati prevelikega zalogaja, a morda se zna poznati utrujenost zaradi evropskih nastopov.Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Holiday program / Počitniški program
Little Timotej: Praprababica of all of us, cartoon, Mon. / Mali Timotej: Praprababica vseh nas, risanka, pon.
programme.desc: I: Brelih Hatunić Jean (narrator), pumpkin Lana (bacterium 1), Harum Lucija (Bacteria 2), Kodelja Anusha (Luka Prace), Pavlin Ana (Little Timothy), Vidic Nika (moon, bacterium); R: Mauric Lazar Martina ... While little Timothy is playing with a koala, they find that they are really very similar. Both have two eyes, two hands and feet, nose ... Then they find that all living creatures on Earth are similar. This is because they have the same ancestor. All creatures on Earth are part of a large family and derived from a single pracel that lived many years ago. This cell is called Luka (Luca). / I: Brelih Hatunić Žan (pripovedovalec), Bučevec Lana (bakterija 1), Harum Lucija (bakterija 2), Kodelja Anuša (pracelica LUKA), Pavlin Ana (mali Timotej), Vidic Nika (luna, bakterija); R: Maurič Lazar Martina... Medtem ko se mali Timotej igra s koalo, ugotovi, da sta si v resnici zelo podobna. Oba imata dvoje oči, dvoje rok in nog, nos ... Potem ugotovita, da so si vsa živa bitja na Zemlji podobna. To je zato, ker imajo vsa isto prednico. Vsa bitja na Zemlji so del velike družine in izhajajo iz ene same pracelice, ki je živela pred mnogimi leti. To celico imenujemo Luka (LUCA).

programme.title: Bees: Under Medved's umbrella, television fairy tale, Mon. / Čebelice: Pod medvedovim dežnikom, televizijska pravljica, pon.
programme.sub-title: Borček ima dežnikotožje. Že dolgo ni deževalo, zato dežnik že zelo močno pogreša. Najraje ima ples z dežnimi kapljicami. Hej, kaj pa če se zatečemo v zgodbico o dežju? Branko hitro izbrskaj Čebelico! Stisnimo se skupaj, pod medvedovim dežnikom bo prosto
programme.desc: Svetlana Makarovic, under the Medved umbrella, reads and tells: Branko Jordan. / Svetlana Makarovič, Pod medvedovim dežnikom Bere in pripoveduje: Branko Jordan.

programme.title: Firbcologists: About predicting the future, chimney sweeps and salt production, mosaic show for children, Mon. / Firbcologi: O napovedovanju prihodnosti, dimnikarjih in pridobivanju soli, mozaična oddaja za otroke, pon.
programme.desc: I: Končar Jaša, Korenjak Gasper, Kužnik Nejc, Marinko Lara, Marolt Kump Jaka, Ozimič Jaša, Perme Peter, Richter Naja, Zemljič Pia, Zoja Javornik, Čuček Kaja, Shljivar Amar ... Gasper got an enko in English. The first response is the abolition of all English words - no more cool, ful ... Not even the word taxi is allowed. Pia offers a solution - what if you looked at the stars? Tarot cards correctly predict all terrains: Jaša and Jaka are in firefighters who rescue the victims from the car, Nejc and Kaja at the chimney sweep, and Lara and Peter in the salt pans. Well, tell when Gasper will repair enko! And what will his parents say! Let's see…. / I: Končar Jaša, Korenjak Gašper, Kužnik Nejc, Marinko Lara, Marolt Kump Jaka, Ozimič Jaša, Perme Peter, Rihter Naja, Zemljič Pia, Zoja Javornik, Čuček Kaja, Šljivar Amar... Gašper je dobil enko pri angleščini. Prvi odziv je ukinitev vseh angleških besed – nič več kul, ful … Niti beseda taksi ni več dovoljena. Pia ponudi rešitev – kaj če bi pogledali v zvezde? S kartami za tarot pravilno napove vse terene: Jaša in Jaka sta pri gasilcih, ki rešujejo ponesrečence iz avtomobila, Nejc in Kaja pri dimnikarju, Lara in Peter pa v solinah. No, pa povej, kdaj bo Gašper popravil enko! In kaj bodo rekli njegovi starši! Poglejmo ….

programme.title: MMF - Young Masters Financ: Mobile and Digital Payment, Playful Youth Cergo, 6/8, Mon. / MMF - Mladi Mojstri Financ: Mobilno in digitalno plačevanje, igrana mladinska nadaljevanka, 6/8, pon.
programme.desc: I: Adrijan Grošelj, Engelman Marko, Klemen Filip Cof, Martina Ronja Usenik, Sara Domio Grgurović, Sofia Lavrac Črnivec; R: Žemlja Aleš ... MMF Young Masters Financ; Amadej and Jean Jošta shine the wallet in basketball. In doing so, the Ajans want to force young masters of finance to resign from the game. programme.desc: Good Morning show is a broadcast of viewers. Through our counseling, educational, entertainment and informative content, we follow the wishes of viewers of all age groups. programme.title: Slovenian water circle: Lepenjica, documentary, Mon. / Slovenski vodni krog: Lepenjica, dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Mihelčič Matjaž... Tokratna pripoved slovenskega vodnega kroga se prične ob izviru na koncu doline Lepene, kjer izvira potok Lepenjica, ki bi mu lahko rekli tudi rečica. Tu voda pada v visokem slapu, za katerim se vrstijo manjši slapovi.
programme.desc: This is where many mountain trails wind to the mighty surrounding peaks and to the famous Krn Lake. In its tranquil and peace, the mysterious valley bears the messages of the past, which today are picturesquely reflected in the surrounding memorials and preserves the memories of the distant past of the Isonzo Front. Through the pools and the Lepenjica stream, the pearls in its pearl water flow all the way to its confluence with the Soča. The story of this Lepenjica water circle is rounded off by the famous troughs of Soča, located in the immediate vicinity of the confluence of Lepenjica with Soča. / Tu se vijejo mnogotere planinske poti do mogočnih okoliških vrhov in do znamenitega krnskega jezera. Skrivnostna dolina v svojem spokoju in miru nosi sporočila preteklosti, ki se danes slikovito odražajo v okoliških spominskih obeležjih in ohranjajo spomine na oddaljeno preteklost soške fronte.Slikovitost tega potoka predstavljajo korita, 100 m dolga in 10 m globoka, imenovana Šunikov vodni gaj. Preko tolmunov ter kaskad potok Lepenjica žubori v svojem bisernem vodnem toku vse do svojega sotočja s Sočo. Zgodbo tokratnega vodnega kroga Lepenjice pa zaokrožujejo znamenita korita Soče, ki se nahajajo v neposredni bližini sotočja Lepenjice s Sočo.

programme.title: Summer concerts from our places - ensemble Sasha Avsenik with the Chamber Group of the RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra, Mon. / Poletni koncerti iz naših krajev - Ansambel Saša Avsenika s komorno skupino godal Simfoničnega orkestra RTV Slovenija, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Novak Tina... Koncert iz naših krajev, javna radijska oddaja z najdaljšo tradicijo v poletje prinaša svoj izbor narodnozabavne glasbe. Tako smo gostili ali pa so nas gostili: Alpski kvintet, Ansambel Saše Avsenika, Štanjel s Slovenskim oktetom in Ptu
programme.desc: The Avsenik Brothers Ensemble, founded by Slavko Avsenik with his brother Vilko in 1953, is still considered the most successful Slovenian band. Sasha Avsenik, with his ensemble, successfully continues the family tradition of his grandfather. This time, the Saša Avsenik ensemble was joined by a chamber band by the RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra. Unfortunately, joint music did not take place in Bled, as was initially conceived. However, the concert is a real treat for lovers of this kind of music. / Ansambel bratov Avsenik, ki ga je Slavko Avsenik z bratom Vilkom ustanovil 1953, še danes velja za najuspešnejšo slovensko glasbeno zasedbo. Sašo Avsenik s svojim ansamblom pa uspešno nadaljuje družinsko tradicijo svojega dedka. Tokrat se je Ansamblu Saša Avsenika pridružila komorna zasedba godal Simfoničnega orkestra RTV Slovenija. Žal pa skupno muziciranje ni potekalo na Bledu, kot je bilo sprva zamišljeno. Vseeno pa je koncert prava poslastica za ljubitelje tovrstne glasbe.Ansambel, ki sodi med klasike narodnozabavne glasbe, je izvedel izbor skladb iz bogate dediščine Slavka in Vilka Avsenika.

programme.title: S-Prehodi: 70 years of magazine Galeb, Mon. / S-prehodi: 70 let revije Galeb, pon.
programme.desc: The Galeb Youth Magazine recently celebrated 70 years. The magazine, which has been moving since its inception an irreplaceable support in the spread of Slovene language and culture among members of the younger generation of Slovenes in Italy, is also a valuable source of creativity. Today, guests of the Young Creator, who have been involved in the magazine for many years, are with us stailustrator Ivana Soban and author Janika Škerl. / Mladinska revija GALEB je pred kratkim slavila 70 let. Revija, ki prestavlja vse od svojega nastanka nezamenljivo oporo pri širjenju slovenskega jezika in kulture med pripadniki mlajše generacije Slovencev v Italiji, je tudi dragocen vir ustvarjalnosti. Danes sta gostji oddaje mladi ustvarjalki, ki vrsto let sodelujeta pri reviji, z nami stailustratorka Ivana Soban in avtorica Janika Škerl.

programme.title: Prekmurje - Cultural History Sketch, Documentary, Mon. / Prekmurje – kulturnozgodovinska skica, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Meško Primož... V letu 2019 je minilo komaj sto let od priključitve Prekmurja slovenskim deželam in od združitve Prekmurcev z drugimi Slovenci.
programme.desc: In the documentary, the main authors - screenwriter Ksenija Horvat and Branko Šomen and director Primož Meško - wanted to embrace the cultural legacy of Prekmurje over the centuries, when the landscape was distant and unknown for most Slovene -speaking people. In the picture and the word, they sought answers to different questions. What was life like on the left bank of the Mura? How did they preserve their Prekmurje literary language? Who are the Prekmurje fathers of the nation? How was the cultural and historical development of the province? Where did the main cultural influences come from and how did the Slovenian, Hungary, German and Jewish cultures go mutually? How did the intellectual thought develop in the difficult conditions of the rooting of the Kingdom of Hungarian? What was the Prekmurje cultural dowry about a hundred years ago, with the merger with other Slovenes? The film revives some of the records of the rich Archive of RTV Slovenia, and in the recordings, it comes to life by Prekmurje, as it was decades ago. The cultural development of the province was thought of by people who devoted their research career in the fields of history, art history, literature, linguistics and ethnology. / V dokumentarnem filmu so glavni avtorji - scenarista Ksenija Horvat in Branko Šomen ter režiser Primož Meško - želeli objeti kulturno zapuščino Prekmurja skozi stoletja, ko je bila pokrajina za večino slovensko govorečih ljudi daljna in neznana. V sliki in besedi so iskali odgovore na različna vprašanja. Kakšno je bilo življenje na levem bregu Mure? Kako so ohranjali svoj prekmurski knjižni jezik? Kdo so prekmurski očetje naroda? Kako je potekal kulturnozgodovinski razvoj pokrajine? Od kod so prihajali glavni kulturni vplivi in kako so se medsebojno oplajale slovenska, madžarska, nemška in judovska kultura? Kako se je v težkih pogojih zakotja Kraljevine Ogrske razvijala intelektualna misel? Kaj je bila pred sto leti, ob združitvi z drugimi Slovenci, prekmurska kulturna dota? Film oživlja nekatere zapise bogatega arhiva RTV Slovenija, na posnetkih vnovič zaživi Prekmurje, kakršno je bilo pred desetletji. O kulturnem razvoju pokrajine so razmišljali ljudje, ki so temu posvetili svojo raziskovalno kariero s področij zgodovine, umetnostne zgodovine, književnosti, jezikoslovja in etnologije.

programme.title: Listen!, Documentary Felts, Mon. / Poslušaj!, dokumentarni feljton, pon.
programme.desc: R: Primoz Meško ... Listen to the documentary foelon! It shows the shocking story of musician Milan Ostojic, who, thirty years ago, together with his family, came from Croatia to Slovenia. In a hurry to escape before the war, they were left without documents. The film narrative reveals their twenty -year efforts to obtain permanent residence and find a new home. In the fight for survival, they were helped by music. The Halgato band, founded by Milan Ostojic, still performs at concerts today. Listen! Not only is an invitation to listen to their emotionally expressive music. Listen! It is a rotating request for some refugees to listen to them with understanding. Screenplay Cvetka Bevc, directed by Primož Meško, director of photography and cameraman Andrej Lupinc. Production of the editorial board of documentary broadcasts TV Slovenia, cultural and art program, editor -in -chief Andraž Poschl. / R: Primož Meško... Dokumentarni feljton POSLUŠAJ! prikazuje pretresljivo zgodbo o glasbeniku Milana Ostojiću, ki je pred tridesetimi leti skupaj z družino prišel iz Hrvaške v Slovenijo. V naglici bega pred vojno vihro so ostali brez dokumentov. Filmska pripoved razkriva njihovo dvajset let trajajoče prizadevanje za pridobitev stalnega prebivališča in iskanje novega doma. V boju za preživetje jim je pomagala glasba. Halgato band, ki ga je ustanovil Milan Ostojić, še danes nastopa na koncertih. Poslušaj! ni le vabilo k poslušanju njihove emocionalno ekspresivne glasbe. Poslušaj! je roteča prošnja prenekaterih beguncev, da jim z razumevanjem prisluhnemo. Scenarij Cvetka Bevc, režija Primož Meško, direktor fotografije in snemalec Andrej Lupinc. Produkcija Uredništvo dokumentarnih oddaj TV Slovenija, Kulturni in umetniški program, odgovorni urednik Andraž Poschl.

programme.title: Caesar's War of the Judge: Invention into Galia, French Documentary Series, 1/2, Mon. / Cezarjeva vojna sodnega dne: Vdor v Galijo, francoska dokumentarna serija, 1/2, pon.
programme.sub-title: Caesars Doomsday War; Julij Cezar se je v svojem neutrudnem prizadevanju za oblast vojskoval z galskimi plemeni, ki so nekoč naseljevala ozemlje današnje Francije. Zavladati je hotel vsej Galiji, kar je sprožilo niz dogodkov, ki so njegovo vojsko pripel
programme.desc: Part 1: Increase in Galma Legions has used the inequality of Gaelic tribes and took control of Galija. In order for Caesar to preserve power over them, he took the gala's greats or their sons for the hostages. Historians believe that one of them may have been a young warrior from the Arvernov tribe Vercingetorik, who was known as a great enemy of Rome. In the mere five years, the Roman military leader has prevailed almost all of Galia, with some unburdened tribes literally exterminating. Caesars Doomsday War / France / 2021 / Director: Claire Benhaim, Alain Brunard, Bertrand Goujard, Christopher Holt, Eric Maillebiau, Vanessa Pontet. / 1. del: Vdor v GalijoRimske legije so izrabile neenotnost galskih plemen in prevzele nadzor nad Galijo. Da bi Cezar ohranil oblast nad njimi, je za talce vzel galske velikaše ali njihove sinove. Zgodovinarji menijo, da je bil eden njih morda tudi mladi bojevnik iz plemena Arvernov Vercingetoriks, ki je slovel kot velik sovražnik Rima. V pičlih petih letih je rimski vojskovodja zavladal skoraj vsej Galiji, pri čemer je nekatera nepokorna plemena dobesedno iztrebil. CAESARS DOOMSDAY WAR / Francija / 2021 / Režija: Claire Benhaim, Alain Brunard, Bertrand Goujard, Christopher Holt, Eric Maillebiau, Vanessa Pontet.

programme.title: TV Clinic with David Zupančič: Menopause - a new chapter in life, Mon. / TV klinika z Davidom Zupančičem: Menopavza - novo poglavje v življenju, pon.
programme.desc: A third of life can last for menopause. Menopause usually occurs between 45 and 55. Bojano Pinter, dr. med., spec.gin. and childbirth, senior saint, from the Gynecological Clinic UKC Ljubljana, Nino Gaspari, co -founder of the Herera community, in which they talk a lot about menopause, et al. Darija Šćepanovic, a physiotherapist specialist who shows some exercises useful for women's health during this important life span. / Obdobje menopavze lahko traja tretjino življenja. Za marsikatero žensko je to pomembna življenjska prelomnica in v današnji oddaji z gostjami spregovorimo o tem, kako premagovati njene izzive. V studiu gostimo prof. dr. Bojano Pinter, dr. med., spec.gin. in porod., višjo svetnico, z Ginekološke klinike UKC Ljubljana, Nino Gaspari, soustanoviteljico skupnosti Herera, v kateri veliko govorijo o menopavzi, in dr. Darijo Šćepanović, fizioterapevtko specialistko, ki pokaže nekaj vaj, koristnih za zdravje žensk v tem pomembnem življenjskem obdobju.

programme.title: Disappearance, documentary, Mon. / Izginjanje, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.desc: R: Andrina Mracnikar ... director Andina Mracnikar, in her latest documentary, disappears into her South Carinthian homeland, follows the questions why the Slovene language and culture are increasingly disappearing from everyday life. programme.title: All large and small creatures / Todas las criaturas grandes y pequeñas
programme.desc: The veterinary eccentric Siegfried Farnon decides to hire the newly licensed James Herriot as an assistant in his Skaldale House consultation, Darrowby, a town located in the Green English countryside of Yorkshire. Illusted with his first work, Herriot soon gives Bruces with the reality of a day to day full of setbacks and challenges. While trying to win the approval of the locals and the Farnon himself, James makes friendship with Mrs. Hall, house keys; Tristan, Siegfried's reckless little brother; And of course the adorable Helen, daughter of a farmer in the area. James soon learns that the most unpredictable and complex animal of all is the human being ... The most watched series in its original broadcast in Channel 5 is a new adaptation of James Herriot's autobiographical novels, published in the 60s and would give rise to a collection turned into Best Seller in the United Kingdom, in addition to several television adaptations. / El excentrico veterinario Siegfried Farnon decide contratar al recien licenciado James Herriot como ayudante en su consulta de Skaldale House, Darrowby, un pueblo ubicado en la verde campiña inglesa de Yorkshire. Ilusionado con su primer trabajo, Herriot pronto se da de bruces con la realidad de un día a día lleno de contratiempos y desafíos. Mientras se intenta ganar la aprobacion de los lugareños y del propio Farnon, James entabla amistad con la señora Hall, ama de llaves de la casa; Tristan, el imprudente hermano pequeño de Siegfried; y por supuesto la adorable Helen, hija de un granjero de la zona. James pronto aprende que el animal más impredecible y complejo de todos es el ser humano...La serie más vista en su emision original en Channel 5 es una nueva adaptacion de las novelas autobiográficas de James Herriot, publicada en los años 60 y que daría lugar a una coleccion convertida en best seller en Reino Unido, además de varias adaptaciones televisivas.

Ilusionado con su primer trabajo, Herriot pronto se da de bruces con la realidad de un día a día lleno de contratiempos y desafíos. Mientras se intenta ganar la aprobacion de los lugareños y del propio Farnon, James entabla amistad con la señora Hall, ama de llaves de la casa; Tristan, el imprudente hermano pequeño de Siegfried; y por supuesto la adorable Helen, hija de un granjero de la zona. James pronto aprende que el animal más impredecible y complejo de todos es el ser humano...

programme.title: Murder in the north / Asesinato en el norte
programme.desc: At the Dun Luxury Gym, someone attacks one of his students, Tim, who falls and enters a coma due to his head wounds. Johann, his father, immediately suspects that L'Atac is a thing of Benny, another student. / Al gimnàs dun internat de luxe, algú hi ataca un dels seus estudiants, en Tim, que cau i entra en coma a causa de les ferides al cap. En Johann, el seu pare, de seguida sospita que latac es cosa den Benny, un altre estudiant.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Asesinato en el norte
programme.desc: An unheard of situation: In a traffic accident in the heart of the old town of Lubeck, a driver threatens a pedestrian with a gun before fleeing. The driver, Silvia, ends up unconsciously in Lhospital, where they are and induce the comma. / Una situacio inaudita: en un accident de trànsit al cor del casc antic de Lubeck, un conductor amenaça un vianant amb una pistola abans de fugir. Lacompanyant del conductor, la Silvia, acaba inconscient a lhospital, on loperen i li indueixen el coma.

programme.title: Catch if you can - special: catch if you can - summer / Atrapam si pots- Especials: Atrapam si pots - Estiu
programme.desc: Llucià Ferrer presents this Question and Answer Contest in which six contestants compete to win the jar. programme.title: Evening News / Telenotícies vespre

programme.title: Wise nature: sea birds / Natura sàvia: Ocells marins
programme.desc: From the Medes Islands to Sant Carles de la Ràpita, from end to end of Catalonia, following the sea to discover some species that never touch the mainland. programme.desc: Someone offers the Harrison's guitars from a limited edition in Batman and Joker design for sale. Then Rick sees himself a bronze sculpture by M.L. In addition, someone brings a needle cushion from the Second World War to the Pfandhaus, in the time of "great depression" the USA was flooded with pawn -loan houses, in which people put their belongings in payment to get cash quickly and unbureaucratically. The depression went, the idea was preserved. The reality series "The three from the Pfandhaus" accompanies the Harrison family, which has been running such a pawn house in Las Vegas since 1988. The spectators can experience what unusual objects go with the Harrison's over the counter and how difficult it is for company grans Richard Harrison, his son Rick and his son Corey to shake the value of things. Ausserdem bringt jemand ein Nadelkissen aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg ins Pfandhaus.In der Zeit der "Grossen Depression" wurden die USA geradezu uberschwemmt mit Pfandleihhausern, in denen Menschen ihre Habseligkeiten in Zahlung gaben, um schnell und unburokratisch an Bargeld zu kommen. Die Depression ging, die Idee blieb erhalten. Die Realityserie "Die Drei vom Pfandhaus" begleitet Familie Harrison, die seit 1988 in Las Vegas ein solches Pfandleihhaus betreibt. Die Zuschauer konnen erleben, welch ungewohnliche Objekte bei den Harrisons uber den Ladentisch gehen und wie schwierig es fur Firmengrunder Richard Harrison, seinen Sohn Rick und dessen Sohn Corey manchmal ist, den Wert der Dinge zu schatzen. Thierry Dietrich has been living in the children's rehabilitation clinic in Affoltern on Albis for half a year. 60 kilometers away from his parents and the two younger bruders Jeremy and Ian. The seven -year -old almost lost his life in a car accident. Although his chances were only five percent, he survived the accident as if by a miracle. He now has to learn everything from his family in daily therapies: running, speaking and eating. At home in Schattdorf everyone hope that Thierry will soon be back with them. «In the beginning it was very difficult that Thierry could not be at home for a long time. But we see the progress he makes in rehab. That gives us strength. »A repetition from 2018. / Das Abenteuer Jakobsweg ist eine Herausforderung - besonders fur eine funfkopfige Familie mit einem Buben mit Trisomie 21. Familie Hosali aus Winterthur hat dies schon einmal versucht. Und musste abbrechen. Nun will Mutter Tamara ihren Sohn Rishi mithilfe eines Esels zum Mitlaufen motivieren. Das Grautier muss sie aber erst noch finden. Ein schwieriges Unterfangen, da ihr bisher jegliche Erfahrung mit Eseln fehlt. «Vielleicht hat Rishi auch Angst, auf den Esel zu sitzen. Dann funktioniert der ganze Plan mit dem Jakobsweg nicht.» Der Beginn einer Odyssee, wie sich fur Tamara noch herausstellen wird.Markus Scherrer glaubt an die ewige Liebe, obwohl seine Eltern sich getrennt haben. Seit zehn Jahren ist er mit Patrizia zusammen. Jetzt wollen die St. Galler ihre Liebe besiegeln und in der Kirche heiraten. Am Hochzeitstag wird auch ihre bald zweijahrige Tochter Svea getauft werden. Die Vorbereitungen laufen auf Hochtouren. Das Jawort wollen sich der Zimmermann und die gelernte Malerin in der Kirche St. Josef in Schlatt Appenzell geben. Fur die Hochzeit braucht der junge Vater jetzt noch einen passenden Anzug: «Ich hoffe, es ist das erste und letzte Mal, dass ich einen Hochzeitsanzug kaufe.»Seit einem halben Jahr lebt Thierry Dietrich wochentags in der Kinder-Rehaklinik in Affoltern am Albis. 60 Kilometer entfernt von seinen Eltern und den beiden jungeren Brudern Jeremy und Ian. Der Siebenjahrige verlor bei einem Autounfall beinahe sein Leben. Obwohl seine Chancen bei nur funf Prozent lagen, uberlebt er wie durch ein Wunder den Unfall. Weg von seiner Familie muss er nun in taglichen Therapien alles wieder lernen: Laufen, Sprechen und Essen. Daheim in Schattdorf hoffen alle, dass Thierry bald wieder bei ihnen ist. «Am Anfang war es sehr schwer, dass Thierry lange nicht daheim sein konnte. Aber wir sehen die Fortschritte, die er in der Reha macht. Das gibt uns Kraft.»Eine Wiederholung aus 2018.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut / SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: Evelyne and Daniel are again on the test stand: Her seven -year son Thierry has to go to Lucerne's Cantonal Hospital for another operation. Eight months ago, he exceeded a car accident, but seriously injured. The consequences were a thread brain trauma and severe brain hemorrhage. Tendons and bander on the neck were cut during the impact. A sturdy plate that was fixed on the cervical vertebrae now comes out. An operation that has never been carried out on a child. How do the parents endure a new intervention on their boys? The search for a donkey becomes concrete: Mother Tamara and her son Rishi, who has trisomy 21, visit two donkey farms. Her idea: In order to go on the Jakobsweg as a family, she might take a donkey with her to support so that the youngest boy can also come along. Tamara and Rishi are now familiar with the animals for the first time. But Rishi makes it on the right and does not want to know anything about the donkeys. For the time being, the ascent is out of the question. Nevertheless, Tamara succeeds in realizing her dream and going on the Way of St. James with the whole family and a donkey? Lush fabric, grinding and tips - actually wedding dresses are not Patrizia Scherrer's thing. And the focus is on the craftsman. Nevertheless, Patrizia wants to marry for her classic wedding in the St. Josef church in Schlatt near Appenzell in Weiss. Accompanied by her sister, she makes appropriate adjustments to her dress in the wedding shop. She is clearly coming with her white splendor? In the documentary soap "SRF Bi de Lut- family matter" three families await an intimate insight into their private and professional life. A repetition from 2018. / Evelyne und Daniel stehen erneut auf dem Prufstand: Ihr siebenjahriger Sohn Thierry muss fur eine weitere Operation ins Luzerner Kantonsspital. Vor acht Monaten uberlebte er einen Autounfall, jedoch schwer verletzt. Die Folgen waren ein Schadelhirntrauma und eine schwere Hirnblutung. Sehnen und Bander am Nacken wurden beim Aufprall durchtrennt. Eine stutzende Platte, die ihm an der Halswirbelsaule fixiert wurde, kommt nun wieder heraus. Eine Operation, die so an einem Kind noch nie durchgefuhrt wurde. Wie halten die Eltern einen erneuten Eingriff an ihrem Buben aus?Die Suche nach einem Esel wird konkret: Mutter Tamara und ihr Sohn Rishi, der Trisomie 21 hat, besuchen zwei Eselfarmen. Ihre Idee: Um als Familie gemeinsam auf den Jakobsweg zu gehen, mochte sie zur Unterstutzung einen Esel mitnehmen, damit der jungste Bub auch mitkommen kann. programme.title: Monos - between heaven and holle / Monos - Zwischen Himmel und Holle
programme.desc: Somewhere in the mountains of Latin America, on a plateau above an impenetrable rainforest, live eight young people and prepare for a war that appears abstract and far away. They call themselves Rambo, Schlumpf, Bigfoot, Lady, Wolf and Bum-Bum, their runner is called Lobo. They are waiting for the commands of an unadorned “organization”. Your mission is simple: the group should take care of the dairy cow Shakira and see that the American hostage, which you call Docora, does not drop out. There are always wrangles, the position in the group, love relationships and how the Doctora should be dealt with. One day, her gruting point is attacked by the military and a bitter struggle begins. Since your location is now known, you get the command to descend from the mountain and build a new warehouse further down in the rainforest. There is an attempt to escape the Doctora, there are again arguments between the young people, there is a refusal to commemorate and the group begins to break up. In “Monos”, young people fought a war that seems without any reference to the reality, without motivation, they cattle up within the group and manipulated from outside. The third feature film by the Ecuadorian-Columbian director Alejandro Landes reminds thematically and of the setting of large cinematic models such as "Deliverance" or "Apocalypse Now" and "Lord of the Flies", but it also develops a very own atmosphere film language that knows how to impress visually and acoustically. The staging of nature plays a leading role. The "NZZ" says: "In the spectacular tableaus, the unnecessary nature does not appear as an idyll, which contrasts the increasing brutalization, but lurks like a steadfast threat in the background: as a huge mountainous, in front of which the children become tiny silhouettes; As a poet jungle that includes it - and ultimately as a tearing electricity that completely devours you. » And kinozeit.de: «When the film finally leaves its letters-transferred point of view in the mountains and immersed them in the moist grun of the jungle, it finally develops the qualitations of a fie-and-abstract and sensual meditation not only over the essence of man, but also about the nature of man Muhsam, muzzling under the Dunnen layer of social norms and aging, and which in extreme situations like this will make its way out of the darkness of our fragile existence. "" Delicatesses "shows" Monos - Between Heaven and Holle "in original language with German subtitles. / Irgendwo in den Bergen Lateinamerikas, auf einem Plateau oberhalb eines undurchdringlichen Regenwaldes, leben acht Jugendliche und bereiten sich auf einen Krieg vor, der abstrakt und weit entfernt erscheint. Sie nennen sich Rambo, Schlumpf, Bigfoot, Lady, Wolf und Bum-Bum, ihr Anfuhrer heisst Lobo. Sie warten auf die Befehle einer nicht naher benannten «Organisation». Ihr Auftrag ist einfach: Die Gruppe soll auf die Milchkuh Shakira aufpassen und schauen, dass die US-amerikanische Geisel, die sie Doctora nennen, nicht abhaut. Es gibt immer wieder Rangeleien, um die Position in der Gruppe, um Liebesbeziehungen und darum, wie mit der Doctora umgegangen werden soll.Eines Tages wird ihr Stutzpunkt vom Militar attackiert und es beginnt ein erbitterter Kampf. Da ihr Standort nun bekannt ist, bekommen sie den Befehl, vom Berg herabzusteigen und weiter unten im Regenwald ein neues Lager aufzubauen. Dort kommt es zu einem Fluchtversuch der Doctora, es gibt erneut Streitereien zwischen den Jugendlichen, es kommt zu Befehlsverweigerung und die Gruppe beginnt immer mehr auseinanderzubrechen.In «Monos» fuhren Jugendliche einen Krieg, der ohne jeden Bezug zur Realitat, ohne Motivation, ohne Sinn scheint, sie kampfen innerhalb der Gruppe um Macht und Loyalitaten und werden von aussen manipuliert. Der dritte Spielfilm des ecuadorianisch-kolumbianischen Regisseurs Alejandro Landes erinnert thematisch und vom Setting an grosse filmische Vorbilder wie «Deliverance» oder «Apocalypse Now» und an «Lord of the Flies», aber er entwickelt auch eine ganz eigene atmospharische Filmsprache, die visuell und akustisch zu beeindrucken weiss. Die Inszenierung der Natur spielt dabei eine Hauptrolle.Die «NZZ» meint dazu: «Die unberuhrte Natur erscheint in den spektakularen Tableaus nicht als Idyll, das die zunehmende Verrohung kontrastiert, sondern lauert wie eine sich standig wandelnde Bedrohung im Hintergrund: als gewaltiger Bergrucken, vor dem die Kinder zu winzigen Silhouetten werden; als dichter Dschungel, der sie einschliesst - und letztlich als reissender Strom, der sie ganzlich verschlingt.» Und kino-zeit.de: «Wenn der Film schliesslich seinen buchstablich ubergeordneten Standpunkt im Gebirge verlasst und in das feuchte Grun des Dschungels eintaucht, entwickelt er endgultig die Qualitaten einer fiebrigen und ebenso abstrakten wie sinnlichen Meditation nicht nur uber das Wesen des Menschen, sondern auch uber den Kampf zwischen Natur und Zivilisation, Affektbeherrschung und dem wilden und ungezugelten Primitivismus, der so muhsam gezahmt unter der dunnen Schicht sozialer Normen und Übereinkunfte schlummert und der sich in Extremsituationen wie dieser seinen Weg bahnt aus dem Dunkel ans Licht unserer fragilen Existenz.»«Delikatessen» zeigt «Monos - Zwischen Himmel und Holle» in Originalsprache mit deutschen Untertiteln.

programme.title: Up and away / Auf und davon
programme.desc: Some plan their emigration as precisely as possible, others leave Switzerland without knowing that they will never go back. Because of her studies, Andrea Eugster once traveled to Norway - today she works on an oil platform in the North Sea. And the truck driver Peter Dorig became a award -winning cap in Finland, but behind it is a stroke of fate. programme.title: rec. / rec.
programme.sub-title: Forschung mit Psychedelika - Sind Drogen die bessere Therapie?
programme.desc: Under scientific supervision, the reporter in the University Hospital Basel is injected several different doses DMT. The hope is to enable profound, long -lasting change in mental illnesses. However, the study in which Robin participates is carried out with healthy subjects. It was only with the help of MDMA-stripped psychotherapy that she found access to the repressed floors. The therapeutic experience with this psychoactive substance helped her to overcome the trauma, she paids. Gregor Hasler is a neuroscientist and has been researching psychedelic substances for years. His latest study shows that psychotherapy with the support of LSD, which can actually alleviate symptoms of depression. Hasler classifies the experiences of Sylvia and Robin and explains where he sees the dangers and opportunities of such substances. / Unter wissenschaftlicher Aufsicht werden dem Reporter im Universitatsspital Basel mehrere unterschiedliche Dosen DMT injiziert. Droge wie LSD, MDMA oder DMT sind in der Schweiz illegal - erlaubt ist die Einnahme aber fur die wissenschaftliche Forschung. Und diese boomt im Moment weltweit. Die Hoffnung ist, tiefgreifende, langanhaltende Veranderungen bei psychischen Erkrankungen zu ermoglichen. Die Studie, an der Robin teilnimmt, wird jedoch mit gesunden Probandinnen und Probanden durchgefuhrt.Robin trifft Sylvia Kahlo, die als Kind beide Elternteile verloren hat und in der Folge immer wieder mit Depressionen und tiefen Traumata zu kampfen hatte. Erst mithilfe einer MDMA-gestutzten Psychotherapie fand sie Zugang zu den verdrangten Gefuhlen. Das therapeutische Erlebnis mit dieser psychoaktiven Substanz habe ihr geholfen, das Trauma zu uberwinden, erzahlt sie.Gregor Hasler ist Neurowissenschaftler und forscht seit Jahren mit psychedelischen Substanzen. Kein Wunder: Das schroffe Felseneiland wurde in zwei Episoden der Star Wars-Saga zum Versteck fur den gealterten Luke Skywalker. Seitdem pilgern Star Wars-Junger in Scharen hierher. Der Atlantik ist rau am sudwestlichen Ende Irlands, das von Felsen durchzogene Gewasser ist ein beruchtigter Schiffsfriedhof. Die Irish Coast Guard ist hier mit einer ihrer drei Rettungszentren vor Ort. Sogar ein seeflugtauglicher Helikopter gehort zum Stutzpunkt Valentia. Jedes Jahr steht das Örtchen Killorglin an drei Tagen im August Kopf. Dann wird Puck Fair gefeiert, eine Art Jahrmarkt zu Ehren eines wilden Ziegenbocks.

programme.title: Irish compass - the four sides of Ireland rediscovered / Irischer Kompass - Die vier Seiten Irlands neu entdeckt
programme.desc: The eastern part of Ireland is a center of culture, but also history. Where the old and modern Ireland collide, a new zeitgeist is created. / Der ostliche Teil von Irland ist ein Zentrum der Kultur, aber auch der Geschichte. Hier treffen das alte und neue Irland zusammen: zum einen die moderne Hauptstadt Dublin, eine IT- und Wirtschaftsmetropole, daneben Newgrage und Knowth, eindrucksvolle keltische Hugelgraber aus prahistorischen Zeiten. programme.title: SRF bi de Lut / SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: The adventure of Jakobsweg is a challenge - especially for a funfly -headed family with a boy with trisomy 21. The Hosali family from Winterthur has already tried this before. And had to cancel. Now mother Tamara wants to motivate her son Rishi to run along with the help of a donkey. The gray animal still has to find it. A difficult undertaking because you have lacked any experience with donkeys so far. «Perhaps Rishi is also afraid to sit on the donkey. Then the whole plan does not work with the Jakobsweg. » The beginning of an odyssey, as it will turn out for Tamara. Markus Scherrer believes in eternal love, although his parents have separated. He has been with Patrizia for ten years. Now the St. Galler want to seal their love and marry in the church. On the wedding day, her almost two -year daughter Svea will also be baptized. Preparations are in full swing. The carpenter and the trained painter want to give the yes in the St. Josef church in Schlatt Appenzell. The young father now needs a suitable suit for the wedding: "I hope it is the first and last time that I buy a wedding suit." Thierry Dietrich has been living in the children's rehabilitation clinic in Affoltern on Albis for half a year. 60 kilometers away from his parents and the two younger bruders Jeremy and Ian. The seven -year -old almost lost his life in a car accident. Although his chances were only five percent, he survived the accident as if by a miracle. He now has to learn everything from his family in daily therapies: running, speaking and eating. At home in Schattdorf everyone hope that Thierry will soon be back with them. «In the beginning it was very difficult that Thierry could not be at home for a long time. But we see the progress he makes in rehab. That gives us strength. »A repetition from 2018. / Das Abenteuer Jakobsweg ist eine Herausforderung - besonders fur eine funfkopfige Familie mit einem Buben mit Trisomie 21. Familie Hosali aus Winterthur hat dies schon einmal versucht. Und musste abbrechen. Nun will Mutter Tamara ihren Sohn Rishi mithilfe eines Esels zum Mitlaufen motivieren. Das Grautier muss sie aber erst noch finden. Ein schwieriges Unterfangen, da ihr bisher jegliche Erfahrung mit Eseln fehlt. «Vielleicht hat Rishi auch Angst, auf den Esel zu sitzen. Dann funktioniert der ganze Plan mit dem Jakobsweg nicht.» Der Beginn einer Odyssee, wie sich fur Tamara noch herausstellen wird.Markus Scherrer glaubt an die ewige Liebe, obwohl seine Eltern sich getrennt haben. Seit zehn Jahren ist er mit Patrizia zusammen. Jetzt wollen die St. Galler ihre Liebe besiegeln und in der Kirche heiraten. Am Hochzeitstag wird auch ihre bald zweijahrige Tochter Svea getauft werden. Die Vorbereitungen laufen auf Hochtouren. Das Jawort wollen sich der Zimmermann und die gelernte Malerin in der Kirche St. Josef in Schlatt Appenzell geben. Fur die Hochzeit braucht der junge Vater jetzt noch einen passenden Anzug: «Ich hoffe, es ist das erste und letzte Mal, dass ich einen Hochzeitsanzug kaufe.»Seit einem halben Jahr lebt Thierry Dietrich wochentags in der Kinder-Rehaklinik in Affoltern am Albis. 60 Kilometer entfernt von seinen Eltern und den beiden jungeren Brudern Jeremy und Ian. Der Siebenjahrige verlor bei einem Autounfall beinahe sein Leben. Obwohl seine Chancen bei nur funf Prozent lagen, uberlebt er wie durch ein Wunder den Unfall. Weg von seiner Familie muss er nun in taglichen Therapien alles wieder lernen: Laufen, Sprechen und Essen. Daheim in Schattdorf hoffen alle, dass Thierry bald wieder bei ihnen ist. «Am Anfang war es sehr schwer, dass Thierry lange nicht daheim sein konnte. Aber wir sehen die Fortschritte, die er in der Reha macht. Das gibt uns Kraft.»Eine Wiederholung aus 2018.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut / SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: Evelyne and Daniel are again on the test stand: Her seven -year son Thierry has to go to Lucerne's Cantonal Hospital for another operation. Eight months ago, he exceeded a car accident, but seriously injured. The consequences were a thread brain trauma and severe brain hemorrhage. Tendons and bander on the neck were cut during the impact. A sturdy plate that was fixed on the cervical vertebrae now comes out. An operation that has never been carried out on a child. How do the parents endure a new intervention on their boys? The search for a donkey becomes concrete: Mother Tamara and her son Rishi, who has trisomy 21, visit two donkey farms. Her idea: In order to go on the Jakobsweg as a family, she might take a donkey with her to support so that the youngest boy can also come along. Tamara and Rishi are now familiar with the animals for the first time. But Rishi makes it on the right and does not want to know anything about the donkeys. For the time being, the ascent is out of the question. Nevertheless, Tamara succeeds in realizing her dream and going on the Way of St. James with the whole family and a donkey? Lush fabric, grinding and tips - actually wedding dresses are not Patrizia Scherrer's thing. And the focus is on the craftsman. Nevertheless, Patrizia wants to marry for her classic wedding in the St. Josef church in Schlatt near Appenzell in Weiss. Accompanied by her sister, she makes appropriate adjustments to her dress in the wedding shop. She is clearly coming with her white splendor? In the documentary soap "SRF Bi de Lut- family matter" three families await an intimate insight into their private and professional life. A repetition from 2018. / Evelyne und Daniel stehen erneut auf dem Prufstand: Ihr siebenjahriger Sohn Thierry muss fur eine weitere Operation ins Luzerner Kantonsspital. Vor acht Monaten uberlebte er einen Autounfall, jedoch schwer verletzt. Die Folgen waren ein Schadelhirntrauma und eine schwere Hirnblutung. Sehnen und Bander am Nacken wurden beim Aufprall durchtrennt. Eine stutzende Platte, die ihm an der Halswirbelsaule fixiert wurde, kommt nun wieder heraus. Eine Operation, die so an einem Kind noch nie durchgefuhrt wurde. Wie halten die Eltern einen erneuten Eingriff an ihrem Buben aus?Die Suche nach einem Esel wird konkret: Mutter Tamara und ihr Sohn Rishi, der Trisomie 21 hat, besuchen zwei Eselfarmen. Ihre Idee: Um als Familie gemeinsam auf den Jakobsweg zu gehen, mochte sie zur Unterstutzung einen Esel mitnehmen, damit der jungste Bub auch mitkommen kann. Tamara und Rishi machen sich nun erstmals mit den Tieren vertraut. Doch Rishi macht rechtsumkehrt und will von den Eseln gar nichts wissen. Ans Aufsteigen ist vorerst gar nicht zu denken. Gelingt es Tamara trotzdem, ihren Traum zu verwirklichen und mit der ganzen Familie und einem Esel auf den Jakobsweg zu gehen?Üppiger Stoff, Schleifen und Spitzen - eigentlich sind Hochzeitskleider nicht Patrizia Scherrers Ding. Und im Mittelpunkt stehen mag die Handwerkerfrau noch weniger. Trotzdem will Patrizia fur ihre klassische Hochzeit in der Kirche St. Josef in Schlatt bei Appenzell in Weiss heiraten. In Begleitung ihrer Schwester macht sie im Hochzeitsladen entsprechende Anpassungen an ihrem Kleid. Kommt sie klar mit ihrer weissen Pracht?In der Doku-Soap «SRF bi de Lut - Familiensache» gewahren drei Familien einen intimen Einblick in ihr Privat- und Berufsleben. Eine Wiederholung aus 2018.
